## What changed and why?

Describe the user-visible behavior and link the issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, and `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm test:packaging`
- [ ] Public API documentation updated
- [ ] Explicit Changeset for publishable changes

Use a Conventional Commit title, with `!` for breaking changes.
